---
title: Overview
guide-section: Get Started
---

ha-automations runs inside Home Assistant OS as apps for the AppDaemon add-on. You choose apps and settings in an `apps.yaml` file, and a deploy script installs a tagged release onto your Home Assistant box.

## What you need

- Home Assistant OS.
- The [AppDaemon](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/home-assistant-community-add-on-appdaemon-4/163259) add-on.
- The [Advanced SSH & Web Terminal](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/home-assistant-community-add-on-ssh-web-terminal/33820) add-on, set up with an SSH key. The deploy script uses it.
- On your computer: `git`, `ssh`, `rsync` and Python 3.11 or later.
- Lights in Home Assistant that support brightness.

## Code and config are separate

| | holds | who owns it |
|---|---|---|
| This repo | the apps, tested and released as tagged versions | public, or your fork |
| Your config repo | your `apps.yaml` and deploy settings | private, yours |

AppDaemon installs the package from the release tarball on GitHub, so your Home Assistant box never needs `git`. Your `apps.yaml` says which apps run on which lights.
